def need(value,reason):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(reason)


class Policy:
    """Per-phase explicit command authority, separate from transport success."""
    def __init__(self,phase,qa,resolve,inspect_plan,step,read,selected_task):
        need(phase in ('launch','inspect','cleanup'),'EXACT_AMAZON_PHASE_REQUIRED')
        need(qa.PACKAGE==PACKAGE and qa.UID==UID and qa.SELF==SELF,'EXACT_AMAZON_CONTRACT_REQUIRED')
        need(set(inspect_plan)=={'search','destination','input','post','readiness'} and
             all(inspect_plan[role]['operation']=='click' and
                 set(inspect_plan[role]['nonces'])=={'before','inspect','action','after'}
                 for role in ('search','destination')) and
             set(inspect_plan['input'])=={'schema','operation','value','nonces'} and
             inspect_plan['input']['schema']==1 and inspect_plan['input']['operation']=='set_text' and
             inspect_plan['input']['value']=='London' and
             set(inspect_plan['input']['nonces'])=={'before','inspect','action','after'} and
             inspect_plan['post']['operation']=='inspect' and set(inspect_plan['post']['nonces'])=={'before','inspect','after'} and
             isinstance(inspect_plan['readiness'],list) and len(inspect_plan['readiness'])==8 and
             all(plan['operation']=='inspect' and set(plan['nonces'])=={'before','inspect','after'}
                 for plan in inspect_plan['readiness']),
             'EXPLICIT_SEARCH_DESTINATION_LONDON_POST_AND_EIGHT_NO_ACTION_READINESS_PLANS')
        flat={role:inspect_plan[role] for role in ('search','destination','input','post')}
        flat.update({'readiness_'+str(index+1):plan for index,plan in enumerate(inspect_plan['readiness'])})
        values=[n for plan in flat.values() for n in plan['nonces'].values()]
        need(len(values)==len(set(values))==39,'THIRTY_NINE_DISTINCT_CURRENT_HELPER_NONCES')
        self.phase,self.qa,self.resolve,self.plan=phase,qa,list(resolve),flat
        self.step,self.read,self.selected_task=step,read,selected_task
        self.counts={};self.used_nonces=set();self.remove_attempted=False

    def claim(self,name,limit):
        count=self.counts.get(name,0)
        need(count<limit,'AMAZON_PHASE_COMMAND_LIMIT:'+name)
        self.counts[name]=count+1

    def admit(self,argv,timeout,mutation,private):
        need(isinstance(argv,list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in argv) and type(mutation) is bool and
             type(private) is bool and isinstance(timeout,(int,float)) and not isinstance(timeout,bool) and
             math.isfinite(timeout) and 0<timeout<=70,'EXACT_COMMAND_SHAPE_REQUIRED')
        if argv in (LIST,PATHS):
            need(timeout==15 and not mutation and not private,'TARGET_METADATA_READ_ONLY')
            self.claim('target_uid' if argv==LIST else 'target_path',2)
            return
        if argv in (OWN_UID,OWN_PATH):
            need(timeout==8 and not mutation and not private,'HELPER_METADATA_READ_ONLY')
            # Up to eight read-only sequences plus four explicit sequences and outer pair.
            self.claim('helper_uid' if argv==OWN_UID else 'helper_path',26 if self.phase=='inspect' else 2)
            return
        if argv==self.resolve:
            need(self.phase=='launch' and timeout==15 and not mutation and not private,
                 'CURRENT_COMPONENT_READ_ONLY_BEFORE_LAUNCH')
            self.claim('resolve',1);return
        if argv==STACKS:
            need(not mutation and not private and timeout<=20,'TASK_SNAPSHOT_READ_ONLY')
            self.claim('stacks',33 if self.phase=='cleanup' else 24 if self.phase=='inspect' else 2);return
        if argv==FOREGROUND:
            need(self.phase=='inspect' and timeout==15 and not mutation and private,
                 'ONLY_PRIVATE_CURRENT_FOREGROUND_READ')
            self.claim('foreground',36);return
        if self.phase=='cleanup' and argv[:4]==['/system/bin/cmd','activity','stack','remove']:
            # Full equality below, not a prefix-based permission grant.
            selected=self.selected_task()
            need(len(argv)==5 and argv==['/system/bin/cmd','activity','stack','remove',str(selected['task'])] and
                 selected['package']==PACKAGE and selected['prelaunch_absent'] is True and
                 selected['cleanup_allowed'] is True and timeout==20 and mutation and not private,
                 'ONLY_EXACT_NEW_OWNED_LEAF_REMOVAL')
            need(not self.remove_attempted,'REMOVAL_CANNOT_BE_REPLAYED')
            self.remove_attempted=True;return
        need(self.phase=='inspect' and timeout==20 and not private,
             'NO_OTHER_IHG_COMMAND_ADMITTED')
        matches=[]
        for plan in self.plan.values():
            for phase,nonce in plan['nonces'].items():
                if nonce in self.used_nonces:continue
                path=self.step/(nonce+'.request.json')
                try:raw=self.read(path,65536)
                except FileNotFoundError:continue
                request=json.loads(raw)
                operation=plan['operation'] if phase=='action' else 'inspect' if phase=='inspect' else 'state'
                need(request.get('nonce')==nonce and request.get('op')==operation,
                     'FIXED_CURRENT_PHASE_REQUEST_REQUIRED')
                self.qa.validate_request(request)
                if self.qa.instrumentation_argv(request)==argv:
                    need(mutation is (operation in ('click','set_text')),'EXACT_CURRENT_OPERATION_MUTATION_FLAG')
                    matches.append((nonce,operation))
        need(len(matches)==1,'ONLY_ONE_CURRENT_SOURCE_BOUND_HELPER_REQUEST')
        nonce,operation=matches[0]
        self.used_nonces.add(nonce);self.claim('instrument',39)
        if operation=='click':self.claim('click',2)
        elif operation=='set_text':
            need(self.counts.get('click')==2,'TWO_PRIOR_CLICK_ADMISSIONS_REQUIRED_FOR_LONDON')
            self.claim('set_text',1)



def current_task_scope(scope,qa,contract):
    fields={'schema','current_baseline_schema','package','component','uid','user','nonce',
        'epoch_sha256','current_baseline_sha256','current_baseline_qualification_sha256',
        'amazon_task_source_manifest_sha256','automatic_retry',
        'original_recorder_manifest_sha256','actual_resolution_result_sha256'}
    need(type(scope) is dict and set(scope)==fields and
         scope['schema']=='pocket4-current-recorder-scope-v2' and
         scope['current_baseline_schema']==CURRENT_BASELINE_SCHEMA==qa.MAIN_BASELINE_SCHEMA and
         scope['epoch_sha256']==CURRENT_EPOCH==qa.MAIN_EPOCH and
         scope['current_baseline_sha256']==CURRENT_BASELINE_SHA==qa.MAIN_BASELINE_SHA and
         scope['current_baseline_qualification_sha256']==CURRENT_QUALIFICATION_SHA==qa.MAIN_BASELINE_QUALIFICATION_SHA and
         scope['package']==PACKAGE==qa.PACKAGE and type(scope['uid']) is int and scope['uid']==UID==qa.UID and
         type(scope['user']) is int and scope['user']==0 and
         scope['original_recorder_manifest_sha256']==CURRENT_HOST_MANIFEST==contract.sha256 and
         scope['automatic_retry'] is False,'EXACT_TYPED_CURRENT_IHG_TASK_SCOPE')
    need(isinstance(scope['component'],str) and
         re.fullmatch(re.escape(PACKAGE)+r'/[A-Za-z0-9_.$]+',scope['component']) and
         isinstance(scope['nonce'],str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}',scope['nonce']) and
         all(isinstance(scope[key],str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',scope[key])
             for key in ('amazon_task_source_manifest_sha256','actual_resolution_result_sha256')),
         'EXACT_CURRENT_TASK_SOURCE_NONCE_AND_COMPONENT')
    return scope


class Flow:
    """Amazon-only object satisfying the actual original Session interface."""
    def __init__(self,*,recorder,contract,target,environment,transport,main_guard,root,step,
                 phase,scope,activation,tasks,qa,inspect_plan,resolve,read,deadline):
        current_task_scope(scope,qa,contract)
        need(scope['epoch_sha256']==transport.FRAMEWORK_EPOCH_SHA256,'EXACT_CURRENT_TRANSPORT_EPOCH_REQUIRED')
        need(root.is_dir() and step.is_relative_to(root),'NEW_PRIVATE_FLOW_REQUIRED')
        self.recorder,self.contract,self.target=recorder,contract,target
        self.main_guard,self.root,self.step=main_guard,root,step
        self.phase,self.scope,self.activation,self.tasks=phase,scope,activation,tasks
        self.current_qualified_scope=dict(scope);self.qa=qa
        self.deadline=deadline;self.command_index=0;self.action_attempted=False
        self._private_backend_transport=False;self._android_mutation=False
        self.binding=types.SimpleNamespace(target=target)
        self.artifacts=None;self.closed=False;self.poisoned=False;self.launch_claimed=False
        self.policy=Policy(phase,qa,resolve,inspect_plan,step,read,self.selected_task)

        def record(kind,value):
            recorder.write_new(step/('transport-%03d.%s.json'%(value['sequence'],kind)),value)
        def runner(argv,**options):
            need(options['close_fds'] is True and options['stdout']==subprocess.PIPE and
                 options['stderr']==subprocess.PIPE,'EXACT_HELD_RUNNER_PROTOCOL_REQUIRED')
            if self._private_backend_transport:
                # Same privacy branch as the frozen recorder: foreground text
                # is parsed in memory; its transport hash/rc remains recorded.
                return subprocess.run(argv,**options)
            return recorder.Flow.command(self,argv,options['timeout'],mutation=self._android_mutation,
                label='Android command',pass_fds=options['pass_fds'],check=False,host_env=options['env'])
        self.transport=transport.BoundArun(target=target,environment=environment,guard=lambda action_attempted:self.guard(attempted=action_attempted),
            record=record,epoch_sha256=transport.FRAMEWORK_EPOCH_SHA256,
            init_pid=activation['framework_epoch']['binding']['processes']['init']['host_pid'],
            package=PACKAGE,uid=UID,interactive_production=True,runner=runner)

    def guard(self,attempted=False):
        current_task_scope(self.scope,self.qa,self.contract)
        need(self.scope==self.current_qualified_scope,'CURRENT_IHG_TASK_SCOPE_CHANGED')
        need(not self.closed and time.monotonic()<self.deadline,'OPEN_BOUNDED_AMAZON_FLOW_REQUIRED')
        self.main_guard();self.target.verify()
        if self.artifacts is not None:self.artifacts.verify_held()

    def bind(self):
        self.guard();return self.binding

    def android(self,argv,timeout=20,*,mutation=False):
        try:
            need(not self.poisoned and not self.closed,'POISONED_AMAZON_COMMAND_NOT_REPLAYABLE')
            self.policy.admit(argv,timeout,mutation,self._private_backend_transport)
            self._android_mutation=mutation
            return self.transport(argv,timeout)
        except BaseException:
            self.poisoned=True
            raise
        finally:
            self._android_mutation=False

    def command(self,argv,timeout,*,mutation=False,label=None):
        expected=['/usr/bin/sudo','-n','-u','#1000','--','/usr/bin/env',
            'XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000','DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus',
            '/usr/bin/droidloomctl','launch',PACKAGE,'--component',self.scope['component'],'--json']
        need(self.phase=='launch' and argv==expected and timeout==70 and mutation is True and
             label=='One native launch' and not self.launch_claimed and not self.poisoned,
             'ONLY_ONE_EXACT_ORIGINAL_NATIVE_LAUNCH')
        self.launch_claimed=True
        try:return self.recorder.Flow.command(self,argv,timeout,mutation=True,label=label)
        except BaseException:
            self.poisoned=True
            raise

    def stacks(self,timeout=20):
        value=self.recorder.Flow.stacks(self,timeout)
        self.last_stack_task_ids=sorted(value[2])
        return value

    def selected_task(self):
        value=self.recorder.Flow.selected_task(self)
        need(set(value)=={'task','package','epoch_sha256','prelaunch_absent','cleanup_allowed',
             'launch_step','prelaunch_task_ids','native_receipt_sha256'} and
             value['package']==PACKAGE and value['prelaunch_absent'] is True and
             value['cleanup_allowed'] is True and value['launch_step']=='launch-01' and
             type(value['task']) is int and value['task']>0 and
             isinstance(value['prelaunch_task_ids'],list) and
             all(type(x) is int and x>=0 for x in value['prelaunch_task_ids']) and
             value['task'] not in value['prelaunch_task_ids'] and
             isinstance(value['native_receipt_sha256'],str) and
             len(value['native_receipt_sha256'])==64 and
             set(value['native_receipt_sha256'])<=set('0123456789abcdef'),
             'NEW_AMAZON_TASK_PROOF_REQUIRED')
        return value

    def launch_locked(self):
        need(self.phase=='launch','LAUNCH_PHASE_REQUIRED')
        return self.recorder.Flow.launch_locked(self)

    def cleanup(self):
        need(self.phase=='cleanup','CLEANUP_PHASE_REQUIRED')
        return self.recorder.Flow.cleanup(self)

    def close(self):
        self.closed=True
        self.target.close()


def open_task_context(ref,util,context,source_manifest,source_verify,flow_root,step,
                      transport,result,deadline,phase,qa,inspect_plan,resolve,expected_scope, *,
                      install_source_manifest):
    """Same held Main/classpath primitives as the qualified Amazon install.

    The only newly constructed object is the phase-restricted task Flow above.
    No original Bili Flow/MainBinding or old UI client constructor is called.
    """
    source=util.module(context.INSTALLED_SHARED/'source_contract.py',context.CONTRACT_SHA,
                       'amazon_task_shared_contract')
    contract=source.SourceContract(context.INSTALLED_SHARED/'source-manifest.json',context.SHARED_MANIFEST)
    recorder=contract.load('recorder.py','amazon_task_actual_command')
    held=contract.load('references/held_runtime_r5.py','amazon_task_actual_held_main')
    binding=contract.load('main_binding.py','amazon_task_shared_classpath_only')
    activation=ref.current_baseline()
    own_scope=context.baseline_scope(ref,activation)
    epoch=ref.module(ref.read(ref.EPOCH_SOURCE,expected=ref.EPOCH_SOURCE_SHA),ref.EPOCH_SOURCE,
                     'amazon_task_fixed_epoch')
    scope_raw=util.read(flow_root/'scope.json',65536)
    scope=json.loads(scope_raw)
    current_task_scope(scope,qa,contract)
    need(scope==expected_scope and all(scope[key]==value for key,value in own_scope.items()),
         'EXACT_NEW_CURRENT_IHG_FLOW_SCOPE_REQUIRED')
    need(util.read(flow_root/'baseline.json',expected=ref.BASELINE_SHA)==ref.read(ref.BASELINE,expected=ref.BASELINE_SHA)
         and util.read(flow_root/'baseline-qualification.json',expected=ref.QUALIFICATION_SHA)==ref.read(ref.QUALIFICATION,expected=ref.QUALIFICATION_SHA),
         'SAVED_TYPED_CURRENT_BASELINE_CHANGED')
    info=flow_root.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid==0 and not info.st_mode&0o077,
         'PRIVATE_ROOT_OWNED_NEW_FLOW_REQUIRED')
    target=None
    def guard():
        need(time.monotonic()<deadline,'AMAZON_PHASE_DEADLINE')
        source_verify(source_manifest);contract.verify()
        need(util.read(flow_root/'scope.json',65536)==scope_raw,'AMAZON_SCOPE_CHANGED')
        ref.read(recorder.APP,expected=recorder.APP_SHA)
        util.read(source.HELPER_PATH,source.HELPER_BYTES,source.HELPER_SHA,source.HELPER_BYTES)
        observation=ref.main_guard(activation,epoch)
        if target is not None:context.verify_target_data(target,activation,binding)
        return observation
    result['Main_before']=guard();result['shared_helper']=source.verify_shared_helper()
    expected=activation['framework_epoch']['binding']['processes']['init']
    proc=os.open('/proc/'+str(expected['host_pid']),os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:actual=held.proc_identity_at(proc,expected['host_pid'],time.monotonic()+3)
    finally:os.close(proc)
    need(binding.same_epoch_identity(actual,expected),'FIXED_MAIN_INIT_IDENTITY_CHANGED')
    try:
        target=held.HeldTarget(actual,source.HELPER_PATH,source.HELPER_SHA);guard()
        app=util.module(Path(recorder.APP),recorder.APP_SHA,'amazon_task_discovery_only')
        init,discovered,status=context.current_discovery(
            util,install_source_manifest,util.verify_source,util.HERE,
            app,activation,epoch,guard)
        need(init==expected['host_pid'] and status['host_pid']==activation['status']['host_pid'],
             'FIXED_MAIN_DISCOVERY_CHANGED')
        values,classpath=binding.main_classpaths(held,target,activation['framework_epoch'],epoch,guard)
        need(all(discovered.get(k)==v for k,v in values.items()),'CLASSPATH_DISCOVERY_CHANGED')
        environment=transport.environment_values(discovered)
        tasks=recorder.task_functions(context.INSTALLED_SHARED/'references/task_scope_baseline.py')
        flow=Flow(recorder=recorder,contract=contract,target=target,environment=environment,
            transport=transport,main_guard=guard,root=flow_root,step=step,phase=phase,
            scope=scope,activation=activation,tasks=tasks,qa=qa,inspect_plan=inspect_plan,
            resolve=resolve,read=util.read,deadline=deadline)
        ref.write_new(step/'held-main-binding.json',{'target':target.record,'classpath':classpath,
            'shared_helper':result['shared_helper'],'target_package':PACKAGE,'target_uid':UID,
            'shared_recorder_primitive_manifest':context.SHARED_MANIFEST,
            'amazon_task_runtime_source_manifest':source_manifest,'Bili_Flow_instantiated':False})
        return flow,recorder,lambda:ref.main_guard(activation,epoch)
    except BaseException as primary:
        if target is not None:
            try:target.close()
            except BaseException as secondary:primary.add_note('held target close: '+repr(secondary))
        raise

def qualify_search_readiness(qa,session,installed,plans,result,summary,clock=None):
    """Finite complete reads; time span qualifies samples, never a future action."""
    need(len(plans)==8 and all(p['operation']=='inspect' for p in plans),
         'EIGHT_FIXED_NO_ACTION_SEARCH_READINESS_PLANS_REQUIRED')
    if clock is None:clock=time.monotonic
    began=clock();previous_clock=began
    need(type(began) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(began),'FINITE_SEARCH_READINESS_CLOCK_REQUIRED')
    deadline=began+20
    result['search_readiness_observations']=[]
    first_task=first_scope=last_key=None
    run_count=0;run_began=None;previous_capture_last=None
    for index,plan in enumerate(plans):
        now=clock()
        need(type(now) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(now) and previous_clock<=now<deadline,
             'SEARCH_READINESS_QUALIFICATION_DEADLINE')
        previous_clock=now
        if hasattr(session,'sequence_observation'):del session.sequence_observation
        seq=session.sequence(plan)
        need(seq['installed_before']==seq['installed_after']==installed and
             seq.get('after_state_completed') is True and seq.get('restoration_qualified') is True and
             seq.get('post_state_matches_before') is True and
             seq['foreground_before']==seq['foreground_after'] and
             seq['post_termination_state']['ui_automation_connected'] is False,
             'ORIGINAL_SEARCH_READINESS_STATE_RESTORATION_REQUIRED')
        current=session.search_readiness_samples[plan['nonces']['inspect']]
        need(current['owned_task']==seq['owned_task'] and current['scope']==seq['foreground_before'],
             'SEARCH_READINESS_CURRENT_TASK_AND_SCOPE_REQUIRED')
        if first_task is None:
            first_task=copy.deepcopy(seq['owned_task']);first_scope=copy.deepcopy(seq['foreground_before'])
        need(seq['owned_task']==first_task and seq['foreground_before']==first_scope,
             'SEARCH_READINESS_OWNED_TASK_OR_FOREGROUND_CHANGED')
        need(previous_capture_last is None or current['capture_began_elapsed_ms']>=previous_capture_last,
             'SEARCH_READINESS_CAPTURE_TIME_MOVED_BACKWARD')
        previous_capture_last=current['capture_last_elapsed_ms']
        now=clock()
        need(type(now) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(now) and previous_clock<=now<=deadline,
             'SEARCH_READINESS_QUALIFICATION_DEADLINE')
        previous_clock=now
        if current['identity_sha256']==last_key:
            run_count+=1
        else:
            last_key=current['identity_sha256'];run_count=1
            run_began=current['capture_began_elapsed_ms']
        span=current['capture_last_elapsed_ms']-run_began
        assessments=summary(seq,plan)
        need(assessments['inspect']['wire_sha256']==seq['inspection_wire_sha256'] and
             assessments['inspect']['tree_sha256']==current['tree_sha256'] and
             assessments['inspect']['window_sha256']==current['window_sha256'],
             'SEARCH_READINESS_SAFE_ASSESSMENT_BINDING_REQUIRED')
        result['search_readiness_observations'].append({'index':index+1,'sequence':seq,
            'assessments':assessments,'observation':current,'consecutive_equal':run_count,
            'capture_span_ms':span,'qualified':run_count>=3 and span>=4000})
        if run_count>=3 and span>=4000:
            session.search_readiness_qualified=True
            session.search_readiness_identity=last_key
            session.search_readiness_owned_task=first_task
            result['search_readiness_qualified']=True
            result['search_readiness_count']=index+1
            result['search_readiness_capture_span_ms']=span
            result['search_readiness_future_stability_proven']=False
            return
    raise RuntimeError('SEARCH_READINESS_NOT_STABLE_WITHIN_EIGHT_COMPLETE_READS')

def destination_editor_selector(qa,inspection):
    """One fresh public destination editor; no historical path/resource authority."""
    qa.inspect_record(inspection)
    nodes=inspection['nodes'];by_path={n['path']:n for n in nodes}
    def editable(n):
        return (n.get('package')==qa.PACKAGE and n.get('class')=='android.widget.EditText' and
            n.get('visible') is True and n.get('enabled') is True and n.get('password') is False and
            n.get('class_truncated') is False and n.get('resource_id_truncated') is False and
            n.get('editable') is True and n.get('supports_set_text') is True)
    editors=[n for n in nodes if editable(n)]
    need(len(editors)==1,'ONE_COMPLETE_CURRENT_DESTINATION_EDITOR_REQUIRED')
    editor=editors[0];window_bounds=bounds(inspection['window'])
    need(contains(window_bounds,bounds(editor)),'CURRENT_EDITOR_INSIDE_WINDOW_REQUIRED')
    resource=editor.get('resource_id')
    need(isinstance(resource,str) and re.fullmatch(re.escape(qa.PACKAGE)+r':id/[A-Za-z0-9_]+',resource) and
         0<len(resource.encode())<=256 and editor.get('resource_id_sha256')==qa.sha(resource.encode()) and
         editor.get('class_sha256')==qa.sha(editor['class'].encode()),
         'ORIGINAL_COMPLETE_CURRENT_EDITOR_RESOURCE_REQUIRED')
    roles=('destination','destination_zh','dates','rooms_guests','search_tab','find_hotel','sign_in','join')
    labels={role:[] for role in roles}
    for node in nodes:
        if node.get('package')!=qa.PACKAGE or node.get('visible') is not True or node.get('password') is not False:
            continue
        for role in roles:
            for field in ('text','content_desc'):
                value=node.get(field)
                if (isinstance(value,str) and node.get(field+'_truncated') is False and
                    ' '.join(value.split()).casefold() in PUBLIC_ROLES[role]):
                    need(node.get(field+'_sha256')==qa.sha(value.encode()),'CURRENT_EDITOR_PUBLIC_LABEL_DIGEST')
                    labels[role].append(node);break
    destination=labels['destination']+labels['destination_zh']
    need(len(destination)==1 and eligible(destination[0]) and
         destination[0].get('class')=='android.widget.TextView','ONE_CURRENT_PUBLIC_DESTINATION_TEXT_LABEL_REQUIRED')
    label=destination[0];label_bounds=bounds(label)
    path=editor['path'];chosen=None;examined=0
    for distance in range(1,MAX_ANCESTORS+1):
        if '/' not in path:break
        path=path.rsplit('/',1)[0]
        need(path in by_path,'COMPLETE_CURRENT_EDITOR_ANCESTOR_CHAIN')
        parent=by_path[path];examined+=1
        children=[n for n in nodes if '/' in n['path'] and n['path'].rsplit('/',1)[0]==path]
        need(type(parent.get('child_count')) is int and parent['child_count']==len(children)<=64,
             'COMPLETE_CURRENT_EDITOR_ANCESTOR_CHILDREN')
        need(contains(bounds(parent),bounds(editor)),'CURRENT_EDITOR_ANCESTOR_GEOMETRY')
        under=lambda n:n['path']==path or n['path'].startswith(path+'/')
        counts={role:sum(under(n) for n in values) for role,values in labels.items()}
        editor_count=sum(editable(n) and under(n) for n in nodes)
        context=(counts['destination']+counts['destination_zh']==1 and
                 all(counts[role]==0 for role in roles if role not in ('destination','destination_zh')) and
                 editor_count==1 and under(label))
        if eligible(parent) and context:
            need(parent.get('class') in ('android.view.ViewGroup','android.widget.LinearLayout','android.widget.FrameLayout') and
                 contains(window_bounds,bounds(parent)) and contains(bounds(parent),label_bounds),
                 'CURRENT_PUBLIC_EDITOR_CONTAINER_GEOMETRY')
            chosen=(distance,parent,counts,editor_count);break
    need(chosen is not None,'FINITE_EXCLUSIVE_PUBLIC_DESTINATION_EDITOR_CONTAINER_REQUIRED')
    distance,parent,counts,editor_count=chosen
    selector={'class':'android.widget.EditText','resource_id':resource}
    selected=qa.select_unique_editable(inspection,selector)
    need(selected=={'node_path':editor['path'],'node_sha256':editor['node_sha256'],
                    'node_resource_id':resource},
         'ORIGINAL_UNIQUE_EDITABLE_SELECTION_REQUIRED')
    safe={'role':'public_destination_editor','current_editor_count':1,
        'resource_sha256':editor['resource_id_sha256'],'resource_utf8_bytes':len(resource.encode()),
        'class_sha256':editor['class_sha256'],'current_complete_target_id_namespace':True,
        'finite_ancestor_limit':MAX_ANCESTORS,'nearest_qualified_ancestor_distance':distance,
        'ancestors_examined':examined,'complete_children_verified':True,
        'container_public_role_counts':counts,'container_eligible_editor_count':editor_count,
        'inside_current_window':True,'tree_sha256':inspection['tree_sha256'],
        'window_sha256':inspection['window_sha256'],'node_count':len(nodes),
        'complete_tree_verified':True,'unknown_resource_label_path_coordinates_exported':False,
        'historical_node_task_or_resource_used_as_authority':False}
    return selector,selected,safe

def validate_pending_input_plan(qa,plan):

    need(isinstance(plan,dict) and set(plan)=={'schema','operation','value','nonces'} and
         plan['schema']==1 and plan['operation']=='set_text' and plan['value']=='London' and

    values=[qa.nonce(v) for v in plan['nonces'].values()]

def make_session(adapter,flow,recorder,qa,proof,helper_uid,search_plan,click_plan,input_plan,post_plan,readiness_plans):
    """Two clicks and one input; original Session.sequence/helper guards remain."""
    validate_pending_input_plan(qa,input_plan)
    class PublicSearchDestinationSession(adapter.Session):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__(flow,recorder,qa,proof,helper_uid)
            self.readiness_inspection_nonces={plan['nonces']['inspect'] for plan in readiness_plans}
            need(len(readiness_plans)==len(self.readiness_inspection_nonces)==8,
                 'EIGHT_DISTINCT_READINESS_INSPECTIONS_REQUIRED')
            self.search_readiness_samples={}
            self.search_readiness_qualified=False
            self.search_readiness_identity=None
            self.search_readiness_owned_task=None
            self.public_search_proof=None
            self.public_search_entry=None
            self.public_destination_proof=None
            self.destination_sequence_qualified=False
            self.public_input_proof=None
            self.search_sequence_qualified=False
            self.search_owned_task=None
            self._action_bindings={}
            self.post_inspection=None
            self.action_requests_admitted=set()

        def instrument(self,request):
            if request['op'] in ('click','set_text'):
                role=('search' if request['nonce']==search_plan['nonces']['action'] else
                      'destination' if request['nonce']==click_plan['nonces']['action'] else
                      'input' if request['nonce']==input_plan['nonces']['action'] else None)
                need(role is not None and role in self._action_bindings and
                     role not in self.action_requests_admitted,
                     'ONE_EXPLICIT_FRESH_REQUEST_PER_PUBLIC_ROLE_REQUIRED')
                need(request==self._action_bindings[role],
                     'EXACT_FRESH_PUBLIC_ROLE_NODE_REQUEST_REQUIRED')
                if role=='destination':
                    need(self.search_sequence_qualified is True and self.public_search_entry is not None and
                         self.public_search_entry.get('public_search_entry_selection_verified') is True and
                         getattr(self,'sequence_observation',{}).get('owned_task')==self.search_owned_task,
                         'QUALIFIED_SEARCH_AND_SAME_OWNED_TASK_BEFORE_DESTINATION_REQUIRED')
                need(request['op']==('set_text' if role=='input' else 'click'),
                     'EXACT_PUBLIC_ROLE_OPERATION_REQUIRED')
                if role=='input':
                    need(self.destination_sequence_qualified is True and
                         self.action_requests_admitted=={'search','destination'} and
                         getattr(self,'sequence_observation',{}).get('owned_task')==self.search_owned_task and
                         request.get('value')=='London',
                         'QUALIFIED_DESTINATION_BEFORE_SINGLE_LONDON_INPUT')
                self.action_requests_admitted.add(role)
            assessed=super().instrument(request)
            if request['nonce'] in self.readiness_inspection_nonces:
                need(request['op']=='inspect' and request['nonce'] not in self.search_readiness_samples and
                     self.search_readiness_qualified is False and not self.action_requests_admitted,
                     'ONE_FRESH_NO_ACTION_SEARCH_READINESS_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED')
                self.search_readiness_samples[request['nonce']]=search_readiness_sample(qa,assessed['helper'],
                    request['scope'],self.sequence_observation['owned_task'])
            elif request['nonce']==search_plan['nonces']['inspect']:
                need(request['op']=='inspect' and self.public_search_proof is None and
                     not self.action_requests_admitted,
                     'ONE_CURRENT_EXPLICIT_SEARCH_INSPECTION_REQUIRED')
                need(self.search_readiness_qualified is True and
                     self.sequence_observation['owned_task']==self.search_readiness_owned_task,
                     'QUALIFIED_CURRENT_SEARCH_READINESS_REQUIRED')
                current=search_readiness_sample(qa,assessed['helper'],request['scope'],
                    self.sequence_observation['owned_task'])
                need(current['identity_sha256']==self.search_readiness_identity,
                     'SEARCH_CHANGED_AFTER_READINESS_NO_ACTION')
                selector,node,safe=search_selector(qa,assessed['helper']['inspection'])
                search_plan['selector']=selector
                adapter.validate_plan(search_plan,qa)
                self._action_bindings['search']={'protocol':qa.PROTOCOL,
                    'nonce':search_plan['nonces']['action'],'op':'click','scope':copy.deepcopy(request['scope']),
                    'inspection_nonce':request['nonce'],'inspection_sha256':assessed['wire_sha256'],**node}
                self.public_search_proof={**safe,'inspection_nonce':request['nonce'],
                    'inspection_wire_sha256':assessed['wire_sha256']}
            elif request['nonce']==click_plan['nonces']['inspect']:
                need(request['op']=='inspect' and self.public_destination_proof is None and
                     self.search_sequence_qualified is True and self.action_requests_admitted=={'search'} and
                     getattr(self,'sequence_observation',{}).get('owned_task')==self.search_owned_task,
                     'QUALIFIED_SEARCH_AND_FRESH_SAME_TASK_DESTINATION_INSPECTION_REQUIRED')
                # This is a new complete observation after the first sequence's
                # original after-state/installation/task checks, never its ACK.
                inspection=assessed['helper']['inspection']
                self.public_search_entry=entry_readback(qa,inspection,self.public_search_proof)
                selector,node,safe=destination_selector(qa,inspection)
                click_plan['selector']=selector
                adapter.validate_plan(click_plan,qa)
                self._action_bindings['destination']={'protocol':qa.PROTOCOL,
                    'nonce':click_plan['nonces']['action'],'op':'click','scope':copy.deepcopy(request['scope']),
                    'inspection_nonce':request['nonce'],'inspection_sha256':assessed['wire_sha256'],**node}
                self.public_destination_proof={**safe,'inspection_nonce':request['nonce'],
                    'inspection_wire_sha256':assessed['wire_sha256'],
                    'preceding_explicit_search_sequence_qualified':True,
                    'fresh_search_selection_verified':True}
            elif request['nonce']==input_plan['nonces']['inspect']:
                need(request['op']=='inspect' and self.public_input_proof is None and
                     self.destination_sequence_qualified is True and
                     self.action_requests_admitted=={'search','destination'} and
                     getattr(self,'sequence_observation',{}).get('owned_task')==self.search_owned_task,
                     'QUALIFIED_DESTINATION_AND_FRESH_SAME_TASK_EDITOR_INSPECTION_REQUIRED')
                selector,node,safe=destination_editor_selector(qa,assessed['helper']['inspection'])
                input_plan['selector']=selector
                adapter.validate_plan(input_plan,qa)
                self._action_bindings['input']={'protocol':qa.PROTOCOL,
                    'nonce':input_plan['nonces']['action'],'op':'set_text','scope':copy.deepcopy(request['scope']),
                    'inspection_nonce':request['nonce'],'inspection_sha256':assessed['wire_sha256'],
                    **node,'value':'London'}
                self.public_input_proof={**safe,'inspection_nonce':request['nonce'],
                    'inspection_wire_sha256':assessed['wire_sha256'],
                    'preceding_search_and_destination_sequences_qualified':True}
            elif request['nonce']==post_plan['nonces']['inspect']:
                need(request['op']=='inspect' and self.post_inspection is None,
                     'ONE_INDEPENDENT_POST_INSPECTION_REQUIRED')
                self.post_inspection=assessed['helper']['inspection']
            return assessed
    return PublicSearchDestinationSession()

def run_sequences(qa,session,installed,search_plan,click_plan,input_plan,post_plan,readiness_plans,result,summary,remember):
    """Each prior action must qualify before the next; post-read always runs."""
    result['search_readiness_started']=True
    current_phase='search_readiness'
    try:
        qualify_search_readiness(qa,session,installed,readiness_plans,result,summary)
        result['search_sequence_started']=True
        current_phase='explicit_public_search_click'
        if hasattr(session,'sequence_observation'):del session.sequence_observation
        seq=session.sequence(search_plan)
        result['search_sequence']=seq
        need(seq['installed_before']==seq['installed_after']==installed and
             seq.get('click_acknowledged') is True and seq['after_state_completed'] is True and
             seq['restoration_qualified'] is True,'ORIGINAL_SEARCH_CLICK_AND_RESTORATION_REQUIRED')
        result['search_assessments']=summary(seq,search_plan)
        result['public_search_action_binding']=session.public_search_proof
        result['search_click_acknowledged']=True
        session.search_owned_task=copy.deepcopy(seq['owned_task'])
        session.search_sequence_qualified=True
        result['search_sequence_qualified']=True
        result['click_sequence_started']=True
        current_phase='public_destination_click'
        try:
            if hasattr(session,'sequence_observation'):del session.sequence_observation
            seq=session.sequence(click_plan)
            result['sequence']=seq
            need(seq['installed_before']==seq['installed_after']==installed and
                 seq.get('click_acknowledged') is True and seq['after_state_completed'] is True and
                 seq['restoration_qualified'] is True and seq['owned_task']==session.search_owned_task,
                 'ORIGINAL_DESTINATION_CLICK_AND_RESTORATION_REQUIRED')
            result['assessments']=summary(seq,click_plan)
            result['public_destination_action_binding']=session.public_destination_proof
            result['click_acknowledged']=True
            session.destination_sequence_qualified=True
            result['destination_sequence_qualified']=True
            current_phase='public_destination_set_text'
            result['input_sequence_started']=True
            if hasattr(session,'sequence_observation'):del session.sequence_observation
            typed=session.sequence(input_plan)
            result['input_sequence']=typed
            need(typed['installed_before']==typed['installed_after']==installed and
                 typed.get('set_text_acknowledged') is True and typed['after_state_completed'] is True and
                 typed['restoration_qualified'] is True and typed['owned_task']==session.search_owned_task,
                 'ORIGINAL_LONDON_SET_TEXT_AND_RESTORATION_REQUIRED')
            result['input_assessments']=summary(typed,input_plan)
            result['public_input_action_binding']=session.public_input_proof
            result['set_text_acknowledged']=True
        except BaseException as error:
            if hasattr(session,'sequence_observation'):
                result['failed_input_sequence' if current_phase=='public_destination_set_text' else
                       'failed_click_sequence']=session.sequence_observation
            remember(current_phase,error)
    except BaseException as error:
        if hasattr(session,'sequence_observation'):
            result['failed_search_readiness_sequence' if current_phase=='search_readiness' else
                   'failed_search_sequence']=session.sequence_observation
        remember(current_phase,error)
    finally:
        # Even a failed or ambiguous first click never causes a second input.
        # Preserve a verified semantic observation without turning a later
        # Destination failure into whole-sequence success.
        if session.public_search_entry is not None:
            result['public_search_entry']=session.public_search_entry

            seq=session.sequence(post_plan)

    """Qualify only the public Search selection, never hotel results or booking."""
    counts=public_role_counts(qa,inspection)
    rows=public_search_nodes(qa,inspection)
    need(before_proof is not None and before_proof['selected_before'] is False,
         'ACTUAL_PRE_CLICK_PUBLIC_ROLE_PROOF_REQUIRED')

         'POST_SEARCH_SELECTION_FLAGS_REQUIRED')

              node.get('class_truncated') is False and node.get('resource_id_truncated') is False]
    need(1<=len(selected)<=2,'PUBLIC_SEARCH_SELECTION_NOT_OBSERVED')
    need(inspection['tree_sha256']!=before_proof['tree_sha256'],'POST_SEARCH_SELECTION_TREE_UNCHANGED')
    return {'public_search_entry_selection_verified':True,'selected_public_role_nodes':len(selected),
        'independent_after_click_inspection':True,'tree_sha256':inspection['tree_sha256'],
        'window_sha256':inspection['window_sha256'],'node_count':len(inspection['nodes']),
        'public_role_counts':counts,'hotel_search_results_verified':False,
        'login_or_booking_verified':False,'business_success_verified':False,'whole_app_production_ready':False}

def need(value, reason):
    if not value:raise RuntimeError(reason)

def public_role_counts(qa,inspection):
    qa.inspect_record(inspection)
    nodes=inspection['nodes'];by_path={n['path']:n for n in nodes}
    def eligible(n):
        return (isinstance(n,dict) and n.get('visible') is True and n.get('enabled') is True and
            n.get('password') is False and n.get('class_truncated') is False and n.get('resource_id_truncated') is False)
    def normalized(value):return ' '.join(value.split()).casefold()
    result={}
    for role,variants in PUBLIC_ROLES.items():
        matches=[];via_text=via_description=0;self_targets=set();parent_targets=set();classes={}
        for node in nodes:
            if node.get('visible') is not True or node.get('password') is not False:continue
            fields=[]
            for field in ('text','content_desc'):
                value=node.get(field)
                if isinstance(value,str) and node.get(field+'_truncated') is False and normalized(value) in variants:
                    need(node.get(field+'_sha256')==qa.sha(value.encode()),'PUBLIC_LABEL_DIGEST_MISMATCH')
                    fields.append(field)
            if not fields:continue
            matches.append(node);via_text+='text' in fields;via_description+='content_desc' in fields
            kind=node.get('class');kind=kind if kind in PUBLIC_CLASSES else 'other'
            classes[kind]=classes.get(kind,0)+1
            if eligible(node):
                if node.get('clickable') is True:self_targets.add(node['path'])
                if '/' in node['path']:
                    parent=by_path.get(node['path'].rsplit('/',1)[0])
                    if eligible(parent) and parent.get('clickable') is True:parent_targets.add(parent['path'])
        result[role]={'fixed_public_variants':list(variants),'matching_visible_nonpassword_nodes':len(matches),
            'via_complete_public_text_count':via_text,'via_complete_public_description_count':via_description,
            'eligible_matching_nodes':sum(eligible(n) for n in matches),
            'eligible_clickable_self_count':len(self_targets),
            'eligible_direct_clickable_parent_count':len(parent_targets),
            'distinct_self_or_direct_parent_candidates':len(self_targets|parent_targets),
            'editable_matching_nodes':sum(eligible(n) and n.get('editable') is True for n in matches),
            'known_class_counts':classes,'current_or_future_action_authority':False}
    resources={}
    for resource in PUBLIC_RESOURCES:
        rows=[n for n in nodes if n.get('resource_id')==resource]
        resources[resource]={'matching_nodes':len(rows),'eligible_nodes':sum(eligible(n) for n in rows),
            'eligible_clickable_nodes':sum(eligible(n) and n.get('clickable') is True for n in rows),
            'eligible_editable_nodes':sum(eligible(n) and n.get('editable') is True for n in rows)}
    return {'fixed_public_role_queries':result,'fixed_public_resource_queries':resources,
        'fixed_known_class_counts':{kind:sum(n.get('class')==kind for n in nodes) for kind in PUBLIC_CLASSES},
        'other_class_count':sum(n.get('class') not in PUBLIC_CLASSES for n in nodes),
        'unknown_labels_identifiers_paths_or_coordinates_exported':False,
        'query_catalog_not_asserted_observed':True,'action_selection_performed':False}
